# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities in Nidavellir privately through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/gianlucabassani/Nidavellir/security/advisories/new),
not in a public issue or pull request. Include the affected commit, the impact and
the steps to reproduce. You will get an acknowledgement, and the fix will be
coordinated with you before disclosure.

Vulnerabilities in the deliberately vulnerable targets that arenas run are out of
scope; those targets are vulnerable by design.

## Trust model

The trust boundaries, the containment model and the operator's responsibilities are
documented in [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md).
